page.overview:
Who is Naggoob?

Naggoob is the Father of Ghouls and the free lead servant of Nyogtha, according to the Unaussprechlichen Kulten. (: "The Horror in the Gallery")

As such, he might be related to Nug, Feaster Among the Tombs, who the Book of Eibon identifies as the grandfather of all ghouls who serve Nyogtha. (: "The Descent into the Abyss") However, in later references, Nug is depicted as Yeb's twin, and Naggoob is identified as the father of ghouls. (: Encyclopedia Cthulhiana, H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands)

Naggoob was created by Lin Carter for his 1976 story "The Horror in the Gallery", and classified as one of the Lesser Old Ones.

In Chaosium's role-playing game Call of Cthulhu, Naggoob is the leader of the ghouls who serve Nyogtha and continues to appear as the “Father of Ghouls.” However, in this setting, it is said that he earned this title because he frequently mated with witches, resulting in the birth of many half-human, half-ghoul children. (: H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands)
